headline: RBI announces ₹14,425 redemption price for SGB 2018-19 Series-II final redemption
summary_points: SGB 2018-19 Series-II (issued October 23, 2018) is due for final redemption on October 23, 2026, on completion of eight years.
Redemption price is fixed at ₹14,425 per unit of SGB.
Price is the simple average of IBJA closing gold (999 purity) prices for October 19, 21 and 22, 2026.
Redemption is under GOI notification F.No.4(22)-B(W&M)/2018 dated October 8, 2018.
who_is_affected: Holders of SGB 2018-19 Series-II bonds maturing on October 23, 2026, including individuals, trusts and institutions.
action_required: Holders should verify the redemption amount against ₹14,425 per unit and confirm that bank or depository account details are current to receive proceeds.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced the redemption price for the final redemption of Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) 2018-19 Series-II.

Key details:

• Issue date: October 23, 2018
• Final redemption date: October 23, 2026 (eight years from issue)
• Redemption price: ₹14,425 per unit

The price is the simple average of the closing price of gold of 999 purity, as published by IBJA, for the three business days preceding redemption: October 19, October 21 and October 22, 2026.

The redemption is governed by GOI notification F.No.4(22)-B(W&M)/2018 dated October 8, 2018.

For investors and advisers, this is a good moment to check the redemption proceeds in client portfolios, ensure bank details are updated, and plan reinvestment or tax treatment of the maturity proceeds.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1369) before acting.
